{"action":"code_exec","code":"print('run targeted tests')"}

{"action":"reason","content":"The new evidence shows regression rather than verification. I should revise the patch hypothesis and inspect the shared behavior causing the three regressions."}

{"action":"final","content":"I will use the current version-4 procedure B; the version-3 memory remains historical context."}
